summary: Milestone 2026.05.243 is a planning-only turn: 0 experiments completed within the timing window. The 12-task roadmap (exp2518–exp2529) was validated and pre-staged. Both RTX 3090 GPUs remained idle at 0% utilization, consistent with a planning-only session with no GPU code path active.
bottlenecks_identified: Conductor did not reach experiment activation within the retro timing window — planning completed but no experiment commits landed before the retro fired.
Recurrence pattern: this is the nineteenth consecutive empty-timing-window retrospective. The retro fires immediately after planning rather than after experiment completion.
No compute-bound tasks executed, so GPU idle state is structurally expected and not a bug this milestone.
improvements_suggested: Activate exp2518 (.243 archive + activation) in the same conductor session as planning to ensure at least one commit lands before the retro timing window closes.
Deploy a persistent conductor daemon that continues executing tasks after the planning turn rather than halting at milestone boundary.
Gate the retro task (exp2529) on a minimum experiment completion count (>= 1) to avoid firing on a zero-experiment window.
Reduce milestone scope to 6–8 tasks to lower activation latency for the first experiment commit.
Pre-wire exp2519 (ARM-EBM v3 no-fallback, retire_if_same_verdict:true) as the immediate Phase 4 priority so the Phase 4 track does not stall another milestone waiting for activation.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Same-session exp2518 activation: the single action with the highest probability of breaking the nineteen-milestone empty-window streak. Cost: zero extra tokens — run the activation script in the same response as the roadmap commit.

Persistent conductor daemon: deploy a long-running conductor process that executes tasks continuously without requiring a new outer-loop turn for each experiment. This eliminates the planning-execution gap that causes empty timing windows.

Retro gate on minimum experiment count: add a precondition to the retro task that checks experiments_completed >= 1 before writing the retro artifact; if the count is zero, delay retro by one conductor cycle instead of writing an empty-window report.
meta_reflection: Milestone 2026.05.243 is the nineteenth consecutive empty-timing-window retrospective — the retro fires on planning completion rather than experiment completion, producing zero-data milestones that consume outer-loop turn budget without advancing research. The structural fix is clear and has been restated across 19 retros: same-session activation and a persistent conductor daemon. Until those ship, each planning turn will continue producing an empty retro. The highest-leverage action is not another improvement suggestion — it is executing exp2518 activation immediately.
